lines.text: Prove you're on the allowlist — without revealing which credential is yours. A Poseidon Merkle root, plus a nullifier, verified on-chain by an UltraHonk verifier. No identity leaked.
The proof makes the commit binding at commit time. Not just secret — provably a valid move, with a known preimage. Garbage commitments get rejected before your opponent locks their stake.
Noir circuits. Browser-side proofs via bb dot js. UltraHonk, verified in a Soroban contract — using Stellar's native Poseidon and BN254 host functions.
